67Y/F with k/c/o T2DM, HTN, HYPOTHYROIDISM AND CKD UNDER MHD (SINCE LAST 1 MONTH)
PRESENTED TO PAHS ER WITH C/O:
1. ACUTE ONSET OF SOB FOR 30 MINS
2. VOMITING 1 EPISODE

PATIENT PRESENTED WITH ACUTE ONSET OF SOB, NO EXACERBATING FACTOR, MMRC GRADE 4, NO RELIEVING FACTORS, NO POSTURAL VARIATION .
PATIENT WAS INITIALLY SUSPECTED OF PULMONARY EDEMA AND EMERGENCY DIALYSIS WAS DONE , PLANNED FOR 3 HRS BUT PATIENT WENT INTO RESPIRATORY DISTRESS AND WAS THEN SHIFTED  TO ER. PATIENT WAS THEN THOROUGHLY ANALYZED AND WAS THEN ADMITTED TO MICU FOR FURTHER MANAGEMENT IN VIEW OF PULMONARY EDEMA.

IN MICU, PATIENT WENT INTO ASYSTOLE AND CPR WAS GIVEN FOR 10 MINS AND THEN PATIENT WAS INTUBATED. PATIENT WAS EXTUBATED IN 07/10/2025 AND WAS KEPT ON INTERMITTENT NIV. 4 SESSION OF HEMODIALYSIS HAS BEEN DONE AFTER MICU ADMISSION.

DEATH NOTE-:
Patients Heart rate started dropping(<30bpm) at 6 pm, following which her saturation also dropped. Bag and mask ventillation was done. Her BP had also started dropping. Patient was intubated immediately. Patient went asystole at 6:20 pm, following which CPR was initiated instantly. Inj Adrenaline and Inj Atropine was given in between. ABG showed severe respiratory acidosis. CPR was continued for 20-25 mins but ROSC wasnt achieved. Hence patient was declared dead at 6;45 pm which was then confirmed with flatline wave of ECG. Family counselling was done in between the event.
